title: Symmetric polyhedral scenes and parallel redrawings
summary: Liftings and parallel redrawings are classical topics in applied discrete geometry, concerned respectively with vertically lifting a $(d-1)$-picture -- a realisation of a vertex-hyperplane incidence geometry in $\mathbb{R}^{d-1}$ -- to a $d$-dimensional polyhedral scene, and with redrawing a $d$-picture (or hyperplane arrangement) within $\mathbb{R}^d$ while preserving prescribed hyperplane normals.
